profile.headline: ML Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have 13+ years as a software engineering leader, growing teams from 0 to 20+ engineers, bringing up other managers, as well as going deep technically as needed. I've managed teams across mobile, web front-end and back-end, data science, infrastructure, and deep technical domains like ML compiler code generation.

I'm motivated by the success of my products and customers and strive to install that spirit in my team. I excel at working across disciplines (UX, product, etc) and find that the magic happens when people with diverse backgrounds come together.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- ML efficiency with a focus on optimizing JAX Pallas Kernels for Gemini on TPU
- Search, tuning, and benchmarking infrastructure
- Building agents to aid with profiling, analysis, and optimization

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managing teams working on ML Compilation at Google, with a focus on the open-source project IREE: https://github.com/openxla/iree.

We work across multiple frameworks, including PyTorch, JAX, and TF/TFLite to target a spectrum of devices, from mobile CPU to datacenter GPU. Experience managing across the stack, from frameworks to code generation in MLIR.

Previously: Worked on privacy-preserving technologies in the health space, and managed teams working on mobile applications for a pioneering project in on-device ML.

patents.title: VIEWING MEDIA IN THE CONTEXT OF STREET-LEVEL IMAGES
patents.description: A system for displaying hybrid image data produced by embedding additional media objects within street-level panoramic images includes a user interface through which a user may view, search for, and/or navigate through additional media objects in the context of browsing a virtual environment of a location at street level. In response to user input indicating a request to view a geographic location and/or an additional media object, street-level panoramic image data associated with the geographic location, in which one or more additional media objects also associated with the geographic location have been embedded, may be provided for display through the user interface. The user interface may be provided by a client device including one or more processors that receive hybrid image data produced by one or more processors of a server and display the image data to the user.

patents.title: Multiple resolution image storage
patents.description: In accordance with one or more aspects, multiple folders are generated each corresponding to one of multiple levels of an image pyramid, and each of the multiple levels including one or more tiles. In each of the multiple folders, one or more files are stored, each file including image data for a tile of the level corresponding to the folder. In accordance with other aspects, a first version of an image is generated, the first version of the image having a lower resolution than the image. The image is compressed using a first compression process, and the first version of the image is compressed using a second compression process, the second compression process being a higher quality process than the first compression process. Both the compressed image and the compressed first version of the image are stored as an image pyramid for the image.
